source_window.resource_title: Official council guidance to live interactive map and Public Register
source_window.data_date: current page accessed 2026-10-03; planning records coverage stated as 1974-present
source_window.license: No explicit reuse licence stated on the source page; Ashford Borough Council copyright/website terms apply.

field_evidence.interactive_map_records: The official page states that the council interactive map provides planning applications from 1974 to present, planning obligations, listed buildings, conservation areas and other mapped records.
field_evidence.live_office_records: The page states that map details are live to office records.
field_evidence.public_register_scope: The page links an online Public Register for planning applications, building control applications, enforcement notices and tree preservation orders.
field_evidence.planning_history: The page states that the interactive map plus application search tool provides substantial planning history for a property or piece of land back to 1974.
field_evidence.application_documentation: The page states that planning-application documentation from 2003 to present is readily available online.
field_evidence.parcel_geometry_limitation: This source window does not itself expose a PA/2024/1920 title number, cadastral/title polygon, canonical parcel bbox or authoritative title plan.

first_missing_criterion: Verified BUILDING_PRESENT canonical parcel geometry/bbox for this producer. Ashford Borough Council's official Access CON29 Data page confirms that its public interactive map carries live office-record planning applications, listed buildings and conservation areas, and that planning-application documentation from 2003 onward is readily available online. This source window does not itself provide a PA/2024/1920 target-specific title number, cadastral/title polygon, canonical parcel bbox or authoritative title plan. Local OpenCode must retrieve and spatially bind the target-specific application/site plan or authoritative parcel/title geometry; after that, bind one exact official DEM/LIDAR tile or metadata-index record to the resulting bbox.
exact_blocker: The official Ashford Borough Council Access CON29 Data page is directly readable without login and materially changes the method from the Planning Public Register Files workflow to the council's live office-record interactive-map/CON29 inventory. It establishes that planning applications, listed buildings and conservation areas are available through the live map and that application documentation from 2003 onward is online, but the window contains no target-specific legal parcel/title geometry for PA/2024/1920. No parcel extent is inferred from planning, listed-building or conservation-area layers; spatial retrieval/join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
